title: RDM Maturity Model
description: Shape of _data/maturity_model.json. Relational rules that compare one field with another (for example that weights and maturityLevels are the same length) cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and live in scripts/validate_model.py instead.

cleanString.description: Human-readable text: no leading or trailing whitespace, no line breaks or tabs.

weight.description: Score contribution of one maturity level, as a string between "0" and "1". Strings rather than numbers is the current convention, shared with the DSW knowledge model export.

versionNumber.description: Semantic version of the model, bumped on every release.

domains.description: The areas the model is divided into. Referenced by name from each indicator.

indicators.description: One entry per indicator. indicatorId is the stable identifier: the DS Handbook uses it as the page_id of the matching indicator page.

domain.description: Must match the domainName of one entry in domains.

indicatorId.description: Stable identifier, also the page_id of the handbook page for this indicator.

indicatorLevel.description: Position in the model as domain.indicator, for example 3.2. The part before the dot must equal domainLevel.

indicatorDescription.description: One or two sentences on what the indicator measures. Reused verbatim as the description of the handbook page.

maturityLevels.description: Level descriptions, lowest first. Three to five levels; five only where a fifth is genuinely needed.

weights.description: Score for each maturity level, in the same order and the same number as maturityLevels.
